remarks: Welcome to Greenwich! This spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath condominium is centrally located in the desirable River House complex in Byram-just minutes from I-95, schools, shops, parks, the beach, and the train. You will also enjoy walkable access to Port Chester's lively restaurants, bars, and shops, blending convenience with lifestyle. The apartment features a bright open-concept layout in a comfortable third-floor walk-up, with a large private storage unit and your own washer and dryer in the basement. Step outside and fire up your barbecue in the shared garden area, fully decked out with patio furniture perfect, quiet retreat to unwind after a busy day. Landlord covers water and trash. Tenants are responsible for gas and electric. No pets permitted. On-street parking available. Schedule your private tour today-this well-located gem won't last long!
